name: Ancient Trinket
description:
You have a small object that was recovered from deep within the ancient structures of the Macchia Ferro. You do not know what the object's function is.

When you gain this ability, choose another player. That player chooses a skill at random and records that information in secret.

The first time you roll 🌞 with the chosen skill, the chosen player must notify you of this. The trinket activates and grants you a permanent enhancement: you gain 1 rank in the chosen skill.

Describe the object and how it activates.
